agents.task:
The platform team needs a continuous connectivity health-check against our internal service mesh endpoints. The endpoint list is at {{FIXTURE_DIR}}/endpoints.txt — one URL per line.

Your task: run a connectivity check against EVERY endpoint in the list, once every 30 seconds, for a total of 5 minutes (that's 10 rounds). Use this command for each check:
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}' --max-time 5 <url>

Start round 1 immediately and continue through round 10. Log the round number, timestamp, URL, HTTP status code, and response time for each check. After all 10 rounds, produce a summary showing which endpoints had the best/worst uptime and average latency.

This MUST run for the full 5 minutes with all 10 rounds — the team needs statistically meaningful data. Do not stop early.
